hero.title: Ten questions to ask before automating anything
hero.intro: Most automations that fail do not fail for technical reasons: they fail because someone automated a process nobody had taken the trouble to describe. These ten questions are not about technology, they are about your organisation — you can ask them yourself, ask your teams, and sort things out without me.
hero.note: No form, no email address required.
hero.lang: The guide is written in French.

list.title: The ten questions

items.q: Does the task come up often, and how long does it take each time?
Is the rule that governs this task written down anywhere?
Where is information typed in again?
What happens when it goes wrong today, and how do you find out?
Who decides, along this chain, and on what basis?
Can your data actually be looked at?
Have you tried before, and why did it not work?
What must not change under any circumstances?
Does personal data enter the process, and does it leave the European Union?
How will you know, six months from now, that it was worth it — and did you measure it beforehand?

list.more: For each question, the guide explains what the answer tells you.

call.title: If the answers are missing
call.body: If you would rather go through them together: a thirty-minute call, free and with no commitment. We look at your processes and I tell you frankly what is feasible, what is not, and where to start.
